lines.t: Paul, breathing murder, fists full of letters,
Dragging off the saints into chains and fetters.
Thought he served the God of Abraham’s line
While stabbing at the Heart of the True Vine.
On the road, dust screaming in the midday sun,
Rage in his chest like a loaded gun.
“I’ll crush this Way, I’ll erase His name,”
Not knowing the One he hunted bore his shame.
Blast of light like Sinai’s crown,
Voice like thunder, knocks him down.
“Why persecute Me?” terror in his bones,
Every stone he’d thrown hit the Cornerstone.
Three days blind in a black glass sky,
Every breath a weight, every memory cries.
You killed Yahushua with the hate in your veins,
Now you’re locked in the dark with His blood on your hands.
No food, no drink in that city’s night,
No law, no boast, just the end of his might.
The hunter chained to an unseen wall,
Every shout in his mind now a funeral call.
Torah burns like fire in his chest,
Every scroll he’d mastered rises to protest.
The Lamb in the Passover’s bleeding door,
The Servant he rejected on the temple floor.
[SECTION 7 – REVELATION OF GUILT]
“I was clean, I was pure, I was zealous and right,
Now I see I was swinging at the Lord of Light.
I was sure I could see, I could judge, I could stand,
Now I’m drowning in the blood on my own hands.”
Bass like a pounding, fracturing heart,
Every kick drum tears his world apart.
Hi-hats hiss like a serpent’s lie,
Synths bend space as the old man dies.
Footsteps echo on the Straight Street stone,
Hands laid gentle on a man undone.
“Brother, receive your sight” is said,
Scales crash down as the dark man’s dead.
Color floods in like a covenant flood,
World washed clean in Messiah’s blood.
Faces he hunted now blazing bright,
Brothers and sisters in the risen Light.
Three days blind, now the world ignites,
Every ancient line turns to living light.
You thought you’d ended Him, buried His fame,
But He rose in power and He called your name.
Three days dead in the tomb of your will,
Now the Ruach breathes and your heart stands still.
Eyes resurrected, vision set free,
See every prophecy aiming straight to He.
Now the bassline marches like a holy drum,
Orders from the King, “To the nations, run.”
From dragon’s breath to the Spirit’s sword,
From blind accuser to a seer of the Lord.
